exposure: Adolescents with low levels of depression
Adolescents with high levels of depression
outcome: Impact of Event Scale (IES) subconstruct score
cohort: This study used data from 303 postpartum adolescents who had previously been evaluated for depression and post-traumatic stress.
finding: The effect of cesarean birth on adolescent mothers' birth experiences was moderated by their depression level, with differing impacts observed depending on how birth experience was measured.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with a decreased likelihood of a negative birth appraisal in adolescents with low levels of depression, but an increased likelihood of a negative birth experience in those with high levels of depression.
